items.title: 17.8 Uses of Group 2 Elements and Compounds

blocks.text: Group 2 compounds have many uses in industry, everyday life, medicine and agriculture, largely because of their basic nature and their varying solubility.

blocks.prompt: Which two properties make Group 2 compounds so useful?
blocks.explanation: Their basic nature and their varying solubility.

items: Uses depend on basic nature and solubility.
